governance.spec_version: CST-RT-040-TV v1.2 (13 Dec 2016) + France TV Annexe technique CDE fichiers HD (24-01-2023)
governance.source: CST-RT-040-TV v1.2 — Recommandation Technique PAD fichiers Éditeurs (CST/FICAM/HD Forum, 2016); France Télévisions Annexe technique CDE fichiers HD (2023)
governance.notes: France Télévisions (France 2/3/4/5). Governed by the shared French industry PAD recommendation CST-RT-040-TV v1.2 (CST/FICAM/HD Forum); France TV layers its own Annexe technique (2023) defining channel-specific timecode origin, audio-track organisation and file naming. Video: MXF OP1a conformant to AMWA AS-10 shim 'High_HD_2014', XDCAM HD422 (MPEG-2 422P@HL Long GOP, SMPTE RDD9) 50 Mbit/s, 1920x1080i/25 (1080/25p and PsF PROHIBITED), 4:2:2, 8-bit, BT.709 (monitors BT.1886), limited range (EBU R103 v2.0, 8-bit 5-246). Audio: PCM/AES3 24-bit/48 kHz, 8 discrete mono tracks (Dolby E permitted on 2 tracks); mono=2 identical tracks, stereo odd=L/even=R, 5.1 per ITU-R BS.775/EBU R91; EBU R128 -23 LUFS +/-1 LU (long programmes), LRA <=20 LU, TRUE PEAK -3 dBTP (stricter than R128 default -1); line-up 1 kHz -18 dBFS; A/V sync lead <=20 ms / lag <=40 ms. TC start on a whole hour (editor's choice; commonly 10:00:00:00 or 00:00:00:00); bars/slate/leader at editor's discretion. Subtitles: EBU STL (UER N19-2002) sidecar, Teletext L1, CPN 850, max 37 chars/2 lines white, last subtitle >=3 s before last image. Metadata: mandatory XML 'fiche de programme' (MetaPADTV template). PSE not specified in RT-040 (regulatory via ARCOM/CSA). Language fr, jurisdiction FR.

codec.notes: XDCAM HD422 = MPEG-2 422P@HL Long GOP (SMPTE RDD9) 50 Mbit/s CBR, 8-bit. MXF conformant to AMWA AS-10, shim High_HD_2014.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.709; monitors calibrated to BT.1886.

codec.notes: Linear PCM (AES3). Dolby E permitted on 2 tracks (20-bit pre-encode).

track_count.notes: 8 discrete AES3 mono channels. Mono -> 2 identical contiguous tracks; stereo -> odd=L, even=R; 5.1 per ITU-R BS.775 / EBU R91 (Dolby E 3/2). Track allocation declared in the XML; unused tracks = silence.

layout.notes: VF (version française) and VI (version internationale/M&E) delivered bi-piste. 5.1 order L R C LFE Ls Rs.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 integrated -23.0 LUFS; long programmes (>2 min) +/-1.0 LU, short (<=2 min) at -23.0 LUFS. LRA <=20 LU. Max true peak -3 dBTP (stricter than R128 default -1). Line-up 1 kHz at -18 dBFS.

subtitles.notes: EBU STL (UER/EBU N19-2002) sidecar, Teletext presentation level 1, code page 850, TC format STL25.01, Latin charset, max 37 chars/line, max 2 lines, white (per CSA subtitle charter 2011). Last subtitle out >=3 s before last image. Audio-described mix version referenced in loudness table; no dedicated AD track spec in RT-040.

metadata.notes: Mandatory XML 'fiche de programme' delivered with every MXF; generated (with the MXF filename) by the Excel 'MetaPADTV' template. File identifier left to the editor's discretion (auto-generated by MetaPADTV).

timeline.notes: First useful image/sound must start on a WHOLE HOUR (e.g. 00:00:00:00, 10:00:00:00) — exact origin at the editor's choice (France TV annexe defines it per channel; France 3 Corse mandates 00:00:00:00). Bars/mire/slate/leader are at the editor's discretion; RT-040 mandates none.

luminance.tolerance_note: EBU R103 v2.0 (8-bit nominal black 16 / white 235). RGB and Y within preferred 5-246 (8-bit); out-of-gamut pixels <=1% of active picture. Active lines 21-560 (540 active), +/-2-line tolerance.
